Life Ledger review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026 · Independent: sponsors can't buy a verdict · How we rate

Verdict: A free UK death notification service: notify over 1,000 UK companies of a death from one place and track progress online. Best for: Families handling a UK estate who want to notify many companies at once.

  • 1,000+ UK companies
  • Invite family to help

  • Doesn't create wills
